summary: Redwood Trust filed an 8-K reporting completion of a private offering of $205 million aggregate principal amount of 7.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030, issued September 15, 2026 under an indenture with Wilmington Trust as trustee. Initial purchasers fully exercised a $20 million option. Notes pay semi-annually each March 15 and September 15, beginning March 15, 2027, are senior unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt and effectively subordinated to secured debt. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
